بَيْعٌ inf. n. of 1 [q. v.]. ―
-b2- It also signifies The hire, or hiring, of land. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also A thing sold, or bought: (Mgh, Msb, TA:) a subst. in this sense: (Mgh, TA:) pl. بُيُوعٌ: (Mgh, Msb, TA:) which is also used as a pl. of the inf. n., to signify Kinds of selling and buying. (Mgh.) See also بِيَاعَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
